notes.title: Nineteen Upadate Notes - 10/19/2021
notes.content:
1. Players will now see an egg floating above Nineteen's head. A chick will hatch and grow as death count increases.
[list]
[*]0 - 99 Deaths: Egg
[*]100 - 299 Deaths: Chick
[*]300 - 499 Deaths: Chicken
[*]500 Deaths and up: Golden Chicken
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41322929/2c8c2bf87c75fbc734c24078d49482c403479206.jpg[/img]


2. A progress bar has been added. It will gradually fill up as players reach a save point in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41322929/959e055da3b207b7927b89c9b1367fe7edba9a60.jpg[/img]


3. Bonus save points will appear when players fail more than 100 times at certain locations.
(Reaching the existing save points will remove them.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41322929/0c43d8e903b13acefa076bfb4f8f78951cb17ebc.jpg[/img]


4. Japanese is now available.
Players can change in-game language by following the steps below:

[list]
[*]Run Steam
[*]Library → Nineteen → Right-Mouse Click → Select "Properties"
[*]Language → Select "Japanese"
[*]Play
[/list]

We deeply appreciate your interest, and your time on playing 「Nineteen」.
Feedbacks will be collected from around the world during the Early Access, and use to improve the game before full release.

We will keep up the hard work to meet your expectations.
